summary: This Old House’s Ask This Old House episode guides a homeowner through upgrading to smart outdoor lighting for a dark driveway approach, a dim top-of-stairs light, and a bright yet neighbor-conscious exterior. The hosts compare LED tape options (low-voltage 24 V) and 120 V strips, propose landscape wall lights as a scalable, low-glare solution, and emphasize practical considerations such as layout spacing (roughly every six feet), wire concealment beneath trim, and weatherproofing. The plan evolves to include a transformer for low-voltage lighting, a trim-down on glare by choosing wall-pack-style fixtures for the garage, and the integration of smart controls (a basement-based neutral-enabled smart switch and an exterior smart plug) for centralized control and scenes. The demonstration culminates with a completed layout and a successful test scene, showcasing a brighter, controllable exterior lighting system without excessive glare or neighbor disruption.
